MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.

2. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

3. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.

4. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.

5. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
6. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological Awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological Awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
